findings.issue: No test script, no test runner, no devDependencies: the app has zero tests of its own, despite ~900 LOC of script logic
findings.suggestion: Install vitest + jsdom + @solidjs/testing-library (the stack recommended by docs.solidjs.com/guides/testing) and add a `test` script; start with unit tests for lib/format.ts, lib/api.ts and lib/data.ts

findings.issue: Home filtering, 48-per-page slicing, page clamping (Number(params.page) || 1, Math.min/max), page-reset-on-filter-change and queryHref's default-omission are all only guarded by e2e
findings.suggestion: Extract the filter/slice/href logic into a pure helper and unit-test: empty q/type/generation, page out of range, page omitted when 1, filters resetting to page 1

findings.issue: Sort semantics are subtle and untested: missing values must stay last in BOTH directions (the `am → return 1` short-circuit before the direction flip), stable name tie-break, and aria-sort only on the active column (:124)
findings.suggestion: Unit-test sortedRows via a rendered table (or extract the comparator): descending power with null rows, tie-break, second-click flip, aria-sort values on other headers

findings.issue: getVersionGroupMoves dedups by `${method}:${move}` (:389) and keeps the FIRST detail's level arbitrarily — the same move can appear at different levels within one version group; also the fixed method order (:404-411) and per-method table omission
findings.suggestion: Unit-test with a fixture containing duplicate details and an unknown method name (e.g. 'light-ball-egg') to pin the ordering and dedup policy

findings.issue: humanize (empty segments, mr-mime → 'Mr Mime'), latestEnglishFlavor (LAST en entry, whitespace collapse), englishEffect (first en short_effect), formatMetres/Kilograms (÷10, one decimal) are all spec rules with no tests
findings.suggestion: These are one-line assertions each; a single format.test.ts would pin every display rule

findings.issue: Cache TTL, in-flight dedup, error non-caching, idFromUrl/apiPathFromUrl URL parsing and the mapPool worker pool are untested; a refactor could silently cache failures or drop concurrency
findings.suggestion: Unit-test idFromUrl (trailing slash, no slash, null), TTL expiry with a mocked fetch, and mapPool result ordering with a delayed async fn

findings.issue: Artwork has a 3-level fallback chain (official-artwork → home → front_default) but the renders unconditionally; if all are null, mediaPath('') returns '' and src="" resolves to the page URL — a broken-image bug nothing would catch
findings.suggestion: Guard the img with Show when={data().artwork} and add a fixture-driven test for the fallback chain in data.ts:264-267

findings.issue: Proxy handlers' behaviour is unguarded: query-string passthrough (:12) keeps apiGetList's ?limit= working, status passthrough drives every not-found path, and 502-vs-404 are conflated
findings.suggestion: Add a route-level test (or a thin integration test against a stub upstream) asserting status, content-type and search propagation

findings.issue: Loading fallbacks render transitional h1s ('Move', 'Pokémon', 'Type') that differ from the final heading; error paths (network failure → NotFound) are untested and indistinguishable from real 404s
findings.suggestion: Consider a neutral skeleton without an h1, and unit-test that getPokemonPage/getMovePage return null only for genuine 404s (data.ts:214-217 swallows all fetch errors)

findings.issue: The 200ms search debounce plus replace-style setParams and the back/forward sync effect (:25-33) have race-prone interactions (typing then immediately clicking Next) that no test exercises
findings.suggestion: A jsdom test with a fake timer around updateSearch would pin the debounce and URL-write behaviour

summary: The app ships zero tests and no test tooling, despite Solid's documented Vitest + @solidjs/testing-library setup being a one-command add and the codebase being unusually unit-test-friendly (pure data/format/sort helpers). Everything risky — filtering, pagination, URL state, move-table sorting, alternate-form exclusion, error paths — is guarded only by the external Playwright acceptance suite, so a data-layer refactor would surface as coarse, slow failures at best. This is the single biggest gap in an otherwise careful implementation.

untested.area: Home filtering, 48-per-page pagination and URL query state (app/src/routes/index.tsx:47-83, queryHref at :9-18)
untested.likelyBug: Page clamping on out-of-range ?page=, filters not resetting to page 1, or a default param (page=1, empty q/type) leaking into the URL

untested.area: MoveTable sorting: missing-values-last in both directions, tie-break stability, aria-sort, second-click flip (app/src/components/MoveTable.tsx:80-124)
untested.likelyBug: A refactor applying the direction flip to the missing-value branch would put nulls first when descending; per-table sort reset on game change (:48-56) could be lost

untested.area: Move grouping per version group: dedup key, arbitrary level picked from the first detail, method order level-up/machine/egg/tutor then alphabetical (app/src/lib/data.ts:382-427)
untested.likelyBug: Duplicate entries collapsed to a wrong level_learned_at, or an unknown learn method sorting before the fixed four

untested.area: Display-name and formatting rules: humanize, formatDex padding, latest-English flavor selection and whitespace collapse, em-dash for missing values, metres/kilograms conversion (app/src/lib/format.ts)
untested.likelyBug: Picking the first English flavor entry instead of the last, or losing the \s+ collapse, would silently change every Pokémon page's description

untested.area: API client: URL parsing helpers that back alternate-form exclusion (id>10000), cache TTL, in-flight dedup, error handling, mapPool concurrency (app/src/lib/api.ts:21-83)
untested.likelyBug: A regex change to idFromUrl would let Mega forms into lists on four pages; caching a rejected promise would poison every request for the TTL window

untested.area: Not-found and error paths: getPokemonPage/getMovePage/getTypePage swallow all fetch errors as NotFound (app/src/lib/data.ts:214-217, 294-296, 349-352); excluded-type names (stellar/shadow) must also 404 (data.ts:356)
untested.likelyBug: A 502 from the API proxy would render 'Not found' for valid resources, and a refactor could stop treating the three excluded types as 404s

untested.area: Proxy route handlers: query-string passthrough (keeps ?limit= working), status and content-type propagation, media 404 fallback (app/src/routes/api-proxy/[...path].ts, app/src/routes/media/[...path].ts)
untested.likelyBug: Dropping incoming.search would truncate every paginated list request; passing through 500s as 200s would turn real API failures into empty pages

untested.area: Artwork fallback chain and sprite URL construction — official-artwork → home → front_default, and hard-coded /media/sprites/pokemon/<id>.png per card (app/src/lib/data.ts:264-267, app/src/components/PokemonCard.tsx:17-23)
untested.likelyBug: A species with all artwork null renders src="" (request for the page URL) and a broken image; a change to the sprite path pattern breaks every card at once

untested.area: Search debounce and back/forward URL sync interplay (app/src/routes/index.tsx:25-44)
untested.likelyBug: Typing then immediately clicking pagination can race the 200ms timer, leaving the input value and the URL query out of sync

untested.area: Evolution chain recursive rendering for deep/branching chains (app/src/routes/pokemon/[name].tsx:21-34)
